name: git-compass
description: Blame, file and line history, visual history, worktrees, branch compare, a pull request Launchpad and AI commit tools, all free on any repository.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Git Compass runs git in your workspace, and git can run programs configured by the repository. It stays off until you trust the folder.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Git Compass needs a local git repository on disk.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Compare your branch, including uncommitted changes, with dev, prod or any other branch or tag.
[Compare with Branch…](command:gitCompass.compareBranch)

Search commits by message, author, file or code change.
[Search Commits…](command:gitCompass.search)

What happens to your branches shows up here: commits, merges, resets and switches. Go back to any point, or bring back a deleted branch.
[Undo Last Action…](command:gitCompass.undoLastAction)

commands.title: Squash into One Commit from Here…

gitCompass.views.conflicts.enabled.description: Show the Conflicts view while a merge, rebase, cherry-pick or revert has conflicts.

gitCompass.views.recovery.enabled.description: Show the Recovery view: what happened to your branches in plain words, with a way back to any point and to deleted branches.

gitCompass.identities.markdownDescription: Your git identities. Switch between them with **Git Compass: Switch Git Identity…** or the status bar. Only names, emails, a GitHub login and an SSH key path are stored, never passwords or tokens.

label.description: Short name shown in the status bar, e.g. Personal or Work.

githubAccount.description: GitHub CLI account to switch to (gh auth switch), so pushes and pull requests use it.

sshKey.description: Private SSH key to use in repositories switched to this identity (sets core.sshCommand for that repository).

match.description: Remote prefixes this identity is meant for, e.g. github.com/my-company/. Git Compass warns when a matching repository commits as someone else.

gitCompass.identity.statusBar.enabled.description: Show who you commit as in the status bar.

gitCompass.currentLine.enabled.description: Show blame for the current line at the end of the line, with a hover card.

gitCompass.currentLine.format.markdownDescription: Text of the current-line blame. Use `${author}`, `${ago}`, `${date}`, `${message}` and `${sha}`. Change its colour with `gitCompass.currentLineBlame.foreground` in `workbench.colorCustomizations`.

gitCompass.statusBarBlame.enabled.description: Show blame for the current line in the status bar.

gitCompass.codeLens.enabled.description: Show the most recent change and the author count above functions, methods and classes.

gitCompass.fileAnnotations.enabled.description: Allow file annotations: full-file blame, heatmap and changes (editor title button, context menu, Ctrl+Alt+B).

gitCompass.revisionNavigation.enabled.description: Show previous/next revision buttons in the editor title (Alt+, / Alt+.).

gitCompass.visualHistory.enabled.description: Allow the Visual File History chart.

gitCompass.rebaseEditor.enabled.description: Open git-rebase-todo files in the interactive rebase editor. When off they open as plain text.

gitCompass.blame.ignoreWhitespace.description: Blame skips changes that only touched whitespace, so lines are credited to the commit that really changed them.

gitCompass.blame.ignoreRevsFile.description: File in the repository listing commits that blame should skip, such as bulk reformatting. Ignored when the file does not exist. Empty turns this off.

gitCompass.statusBar.branch.enabled.description: Show where you are in plain words in the status bar (for example "feature/x · 3 commits ahead of main" or "Editing main directly"), with the next step to take.

gitCompass.baseBranches.description: Branches used for ahead/behind counts and offered first when comparing, e.g. ["dev", "prod"]. Empty uses the remote default branch. origin/<name> is used when it exists.

gitCompass.protectedBranches.description: The branch status bar turns amber while one of these is checked out.

gitCompass.branchCleanup.staleDays.description: Clean Up Branches suggests local branches with no commits for this many days. 0 turns stale suggestions off.

gitCompass.launchpad.statusBar.enabled.description: Show pull requests that need you (to review, blocked, ready) in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: GitLab when origin is on a host with "gitlab" in its name, otherwise GitHub
gitCompass.launchpad.provider.description: Where Launchpad, Create Pull Request and Merge get pull requests (GitHub) or merge requests (GitLab) from.

gitCompass.pr.defaultDraft.description: Tick "Create as draft" by default in the Create Pull Request form.

gitCompass.pr.deleteBranchAfterMerge.description: Offer "delete the branch after merging" as the first choice when merging a pull request.

gitCompass.prePush.enabled.description: Before Git Compass pushes a branch, check its commits for possible secrets, conflict markers, debug code, large files, commits made as the wrong identity and fixup commits, and ask before pushing if anything turns up.

gitCompass.prePush.debugPatterns.description: Regular expressions for debug code in added lines. Documentation and lock files are skipped.

gitCompass.prePush.ticketPattern.description: Regular expression every commit message must match, such as "[A-Z]+-\d+" for Jira keys. Empty turns this check off.

gitCompass.prePush.maxFileSizeKB.description: Warn about added or changed files larger than this many KB. 0 turns this check off.

enumDescriptions: A command-line agent you choose (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or any custom tool).
Any OpenAI-compatible API: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio or your own gateway.
The Anthropic Messages API with your own key.
A VS Code language model, such as GitHub Copilot or another installed model provider.
gitCompass.ai.provider.markdownDescription: Where AI requests go. Run **Git Compass: Set Up AI Provider** to configure it step by step. Nothing is sent anywhere while this is `none`.

gitCompass.ai.cli.command.markdownDescription: Executable for the `cli` provider, e.g. `claude`, `codex` or a full path.

gitCompass.ai.cli.args.markdownDescription: Arguments for the command. `{prompt}` is replaced with the prompt text (argument mode only). `{outputFile}` is replaced with a temporary file path; when present, the answer is read from that file instead of standard output.

enumDescriptions: Pipe the prompt to the command's standard input.
Put the prompt where {prompt} appears in the arguments. Very long prompts, and all prompts on Windows, still go through standard input.
gitCompass.ai.cli.promptInput.description: How the command receives the prompt.

gitCompass.ai.openaiCompatible.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API (the part before `/chat/completions`), e.g. `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` or `http://localhost:11434/v1`.

gitCompass.ai.openaiCompatible.model.description: Model ID exactly as your provider lists it.

gitCompass.ai.anthropic.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Anthropic API or a compatible proxy.

gitCompass.ai.vscodeLm.vendor.markdownDescription: Optional language model vendor, e.g. `copilot`. Empty uses any available model.

gitCompass.ai.vscodeLm.family.description: Optional language model family. Empty uses any family from the vendor.

gitCompass.ai.apiKeyEnvVar.markdownDescription: Optional name of an environment variable holding the API key (e.g. `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`), used when no key is stored. Keys set with **Git Compass: Set AI API Key** live in VS Code secret storage, never in settings.

gitCompass.ai.maxContextChars.description: Maximum characters of diff and commit text sent with one request. Longer input is cut, and the model is told.

gitCompass.ai.timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for an answer before giving up.

colors.description: Colour of the blame text shown at the end of the current line.
